The '''New Republic Intelligence Headquarters''', code named '''Mirage''', was the central operations headquarters of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Intelligence Service|Intelligence Service]]. It was located in a [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower level]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] called [[The Abyss (Coruscant)|The Abyss]].
